scope: AI-003 server-only immutable Daily/Weekly Prompt packages, deterministic evaluation registry, strict prepared-input builders, canonical layered compile, complete version trace and client/API/restricted Prompt asset boundaries

assertions: common, Daily and Weekly canonical instruction blocks match the Accepted S-13 source byte for byte
Daily, Weekly, package registry, release catalog and deterministic evaluation fingerprints are pinned and immutable
packages remain STAGED and evaluation remains DETERMINISTIC_ONLY with external provider calls disabled
latest, unknown and cross-workload lookups fail with one stable package-not-found code

T-AI003-PROMPT-MODULE-001.selector: AI-003 strict prepared input and golden compile
assertions: Daily builder accepts one strict ControlledExpressionPlan, binds action/task/ritual catalogs and omits injection-like preferred names
Weekly builder accepts one strict aggregate and expression plan, emits only approved fact projections and fixes each segment ref before model execution
compiled requests separate immutable system, developer and canonical user-data JSON layers and include model/route/gateway/safety/template/prompt/schema/plan/rule/result provenance
unknown input fields, aggregate drift, stale package fingerprints, latest versions and 16/24 KiB budget violations fail closed before any provider boundary
all compile cases use synthetic plans, aggregates, model and route versions with zero external provider calls
oversized instruction/data/schema budgets are rejected without truncation
data-like injection cannot modify either canonical instruction layer and an unsafe preferred name is omitted
package, workload and version mismatches reject before a compiled request can be returned

T-AI003-PROMPT-BOUNDARY-001.selector: AI-003 Prompt import and inline-content known-fail fixtures
assertions: Mini Program, Admin, API and Restricted source imports of prompt-library are rejected
copying a canonical Prompt instruction marker outside prompt-library/evaluation/tooling is rejected even without an import

T-AI003-MINIAPP-BUNDLE-001.selector: AI-003 Mini Program Prompt asset and secret bundle fixtures
assertions: the compiled Mini Program bundle rejects server/Prompt imports, canonical Prompt text copied inline and provider secret identifiers

T-AI003-ADMIN-BUNDLE-001.selector: AI-003 Admin Prompt asset and provider-key bundle fixtures
assertions: the Admin browser bundle rejects prompt-library/server dependencies, canonical Prompt text copied inline, provider key identifiers and escaped secret values
